protocol: v4 opt1_e6 checkpoint; fixed 16 posterior samples; full 329-trial test; no training. Selected C/G override sets C=0.01, G=0.5 for AVDL/AVDR/ASHR/AVER (fastCG_selected) or all 300 neurons (fastCG_all).
conclusion: Fast membrane C/G does not improve full-test hop1 correlation; global fast C/G severely degrades it. The 16-trial zero-shot gain was sampling noise. Membrane C/G is not the next lever.
